fields.label: Part of
fields.description: A part sits under one of the seven areas of life.

fields.label: One of the seven areas of life
fields.description: Career, Health, Relationships, Money, Emotions, Mind or Environment. Every other area is a part of one of them.

fields.label: On
fields.description: An area that is off is hidden with its parts, goals and tasks, and the Brain does not file into it. Nothing is deleted.

fields.description: The dot beside the area in the lens and the sidebar.

fields.label: Pinned to the sidebar
fields.description: Shown under "Focus on an area" as a one-click lens.

fields.label: Focus
fields.description: A focus is ongoing work under a part (or an area of life): it has a standard and principles, and expects an annual goal. Nothing goes below it.

fields.label: Kind of part
fields.description: The kind of part decides which focuses Life OS offers for it.

fields.label: Standard
fields.description: One or two lines on what good looks like.

fields.label: Principles
fields.description: Short lines on how to work, in order.
